_notes: Every entry here must be a verbatim public review. The first three are from the restaurant's current website. Live Google reviews are merged in automatically when GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY and GOOGLE_PLACE_ID are set (Google's API returns at most 5). To add more, copy-paste from the Google Business profile: name, stars, text, and the review date if known. Never write, edit, merge or embellish review text.

aggregate._note: Owner-provided Google numbers, September 2026. Replaced by the live API value when connected.

reviews.name: Steve T.
reviews.text: Had dinner with 2 of my sons here and we will definitely be back. We all ordered different entrees and each one was great. We also liked the ambiance of the place.

reviews.name: Kirsten B.
reviews.text: Delicious!! So many options and everything we tried was so good (we have leftovers for days because I wanted to try it all!!) We were enjoying the whole experience! Delicious Lamb Pasanda is one of the most delicious things I have ever eaten!

reviews.name: Sarah O.
reviews.text: Good quality and fast service. We arrived thirty minutes before they closed but we were immediately greeted and sat at a table. The food was delicious. Highly recommend the Samosas.
